status: retrospective extension specified before computing the additional contrasts
scope: Display the observed study material and test two gaps in the existing measurement and population-prediction analyses. Frozen historical results remain unchanged.

measurement.threshold: Reuse the saved discovery two-Gaussian midpoint without refitting
measurement.unit: Author-mapped patient; repeated specimens pooled by their relevant cell denominator
measurement.contrast: healed minus not healed, seven versus four patients
measurement.inference: All 330 patient-label allocations; absolute two-sided statistic including ties; no add-one for exhaustive enumeration; BH adjustment over these three new readouts
measurement.uncertainty: 10000 stratified patient bootstrap draws, seed 17; percentile intervals are descriptive in this small retrospective cohort
sensitivities: omit one patient at a time
repeat specimens must each contain at least 100 fibroblasts
measurement.visualization: UMAP on centered log ratios of the saved 15-topic proportions, 30 neighbors, minimum distance 0.3, seed 17; display a uniform 2000-cell subset. Raw-count marker displays do not constitute independent validation of marker-derived labels.

population.training: Freeze discovery encoder; exclude every held-time cell from scaling and fitting; connect consecutive remaining times within donor; retain original paired product coupling, 8000 optimization steps and batch size 256
population.prediction: Start at the observed time immediately before the held time; the next observed time is the training anchor; rank-time interpolation fraction is fixed before evaluation
population.evaluation: Full 15-dimensional empirical energy distance with all available cells within each donor; average donor-specific errors with equal donor weight. Report every donor and seed, with no significance claim from seeds or cells.
population.visualization: Fit two principal components only on the day-7 training coordinates. Project all times and fixed model predictions; projected paths are model curves and not tracked cell lineages.

limits: No new recruitment, histology, perturbation experiment, spatial localization, DFU trajectory or independent clinical validation is supplied by these computations.
